title: Welding, Soldering, and Brazing Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders
description: Set up, operate, or tend welding, soldering, or brazing machines or robots that weld, braze, solder, or heat treat metal products, components, or assemblies. Includes workers who operate laser cutters or laser-beam machines.

projection.title: Welding, soldering, and brazing machine setters, operators, and tenders

tasks.text: Read blueprints, work orders, or production schedules to determine product or job instructions or specifications.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.
Review blueprints or other instructions to determine operational methods or sequences.

tasks.text: Inspect, measure, or test completed metal workpieces to ensure conformance to specifications, using measuring and testing devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Record operational information on specified production reports.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Correct problems by adjusting controls or by stopping machines and opening holding devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual welding requires dexterity and live judgment

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Set up, operate, or tend welding machines that join or bond components to fabricate metal products or assemblies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual welding requires dexterity and live judgment

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Select torch tips, alloys, flux, coil, tubing, or wire, according to metal types or thicknesses, data charts, or records.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: Lay out, fit, or connect parts to be bonded, calculating production measurements, as necessary.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Laying out parts is hands-on staging

dwas.name: Assemble metal or plastic parts or products.
Lay out parts to prepare for assembly.

tasks.text: Prepare metal surfaces or workpieces, using hand-operated equipment, such as grinders, cutters, or drills.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Grinding requires hands-on control and feel

dwas.name: Reshape metal workpieces to established specifications.
Operate grinding equipment.
Operate cutting equipment.

tasks.text: Mark weld points and positions of components on workpieces, using rules, squares, templates, or scribes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drawing guide lines on materials is hands-on

dwas.name: Draw guide lines or markings on materials or workpieces using patterns or other references.

tasks.text: Set dials and timing controls to regulate electrical current, gas flow pressure, heating or cooling cycles, or shut-off.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual gas flow control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust equipment controls to regulate gas flow.
Adjust flow of electricity to tools or production equipment.

tasks.text: Turn and press knobs and buttons or enter operating instructions into computers to adjust and start welding machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Command entry often needs physical equipment interface

dwas.name: Enter commands, instructions, or specifications into equipment.

tasks.text: Assemble, align, and clamp workpieces into holding fixtures to bond, heat-treat, or solder fabricated metal components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning parts for assembly needs hands and judgment

dwas.name: Assemble metal or plastic parts or products.
Align parts or workpieces to ensure proper assembly.

tasks.text: Conduct trial runs before welding, soldering, or brazing, and make necessary adjustments to equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating production equipment physically on site

dwas.name: Conduct test runs of production equipment.

tasks.text: Give directions to other workers regarding machine set-up and use.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Directing production operations is human supervisory authority

dwas.name: Direct operational or production activities.

tasks.text: Clean, lubricate, maintain, and adjust equipment to maintain efficient operation, using air hoses, cleaning fluids, and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.
Lubricate production equipment.

tasks.text: Select, position, align, and bolt jigs, holding fixtures, guides, or stops onto machines, using measuring instruments and hand tools.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.
Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Remove completed workpieces or parts from machinery, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Observe meters, gauges, or machine operations to ensure that soldering or brazing processes meet specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Sensor/vision monitoring possible, but physical verification and accountability remain human

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure proper functioning.

tasks.text: Transfer components, metal products, or assemblies, using moving equipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical moving of products between work areas

dwas.name: Move products, materials, or equipment between work areas.

tasks.text: Devise or build fixtures or jigs used to hold parts in place during welding, brazing, or soldering.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI drafts tooling; machinist and engineer verify

dwas.name: Assemble machine tools, parts, or fixtures.
Design tools, fixtures, or other devices for production equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Drafting, Laying Out, and Specifying Technical Devices, Parts, and Equipment

tasks.text: Add chemicals or materials to workpieces or machines to facilitate bonding or to cool workpieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying solutions to equipment is manual

dwas.name: Apply solutions to production equipment.
Apply lubricants or coolants to workpieces.

tasks.text: Tend auxiliary equipment used in welding processes.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual welding requires dexterity and live judgment

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Compute and record settings for new work, applying knowledge of metal properties, principles of welding, and shop mathematics.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Calculate specific material, equipment, or labor requirements for production.
Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Anneal finished workpieces to relieve internal stress.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Heating workpieces requires physical operation

dwas.name: Heat material or workpieces to prepare for or complete production.

tasks.text: Load or feed workpieces into welding machines to join or bond components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Fill hoppers and position spouts to direct flow of flux or manually brush flux onto seams of workpieces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Solder parts or workpieces.

tasks.text: Start, monitor, and adjust robotic welding production lines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual welding requires dexterity and live judgment

dwas.name: Operate welding equipment.

tasks.text: Dress electrodes, using tip dressers, files, emery cloths, or dressing wheels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Soldering requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Solder parts or workpieces.

tasks.text: Immerse completed workpieces into water or acid baths to cool and clean components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Immersing workpieces in solutions by hand

dwas.name: Immerse objects or workpieces in cleaning or coating solutions.
